fusions.name: Barbed Thrust
fusions.desc: Lunges at a target up to 6 tiles away, dealing 9 damage, up to 2 times that at full range. Holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Doorway Strike
fusions.desc: Sends a piercing bolt into the first enemy it meets, dealing 30 damage. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Waiting Launch
fusions.desc: Launches you 6 tiles forward in a burst.

fusions.name: Aimed Rest
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, your next ability deals 25% more damage. Once every 6 seconds.
